summary: Wildfire has curves that are our judgment (2 parts); flood has curves built from borrowed evidence (GSU substation only); hurricane wind and convective wind have curves built from borrowed and our judgment evidence (hurricane wind: tower only and convective wind: 5 parts); hail has no cell yet. 4 parts of the wind farm have no curve under any hazard: collection network, control building, SCADA, met and O&M, civil and fieldwork and transport support.
summary_v0: Flood, hurricane wind, convective wind and wildfire have curves for wind farms, all on borrowed evidence or our judgment; hail has none; nobody has yet searched for field reports.

hazards.label: Heat
hazards.effect_note: The twin's heat leads (ageing, derating, chiller capacity) work through performance, not physical damage; pointer to the outage-as-performance work, no curve (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Icing
hazards.effect_note: Two leads in the twin: snow load on the venting panels (physical, L) and cold limiting the charge rate until heated (performance, L). No hazard cell; the C-172 snow-and-ice reasoning applies (discussion 04 §6).

hazards.label: Lightning
hazards.effect_note: No hazard cell exists; the twin carries Medium surge leads on the electronics (discussion 04 §6).

split.sentence: These cells split the wind farm differently: the cells name different numbers of parts: flood 15, hurricane wind 10, wildfire 12 and convective wind 5; collection network is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; convective wind lists it as no curve yet; GSU substation is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; convective wind lists it as no curve yet; control building, SCADA, met and O&M is a unit under hurricane wind and wildfire; flood and convective wind list it as no curve yet; civil: roads, pads, buildings, fences is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; convective wind lists it as no curve yet; fieldwork and transport support is a unit under flood, hurricane wind and wildfire; convective wind does not mention it; and more below. No reference plant budget exists for wind farms in this repository; the hurricane cell carries the only plant value (the canonical 100 MW farm, $140M, of which the tower share is 0.16).
